t: This is Portland Place, an unusually wide street in Marylebone. It takes its name from the 3rd Duke of Portland, who was Prime Minister twice, with a gap of twenty-three years between his terms, the longest of any British prime minister. Along the street you'll find the BBC's Broadcasting House, the Chinese and Polish embassies and the Royal Institute of British Architects. General Thomas Gage, who commanded British forces in North America in the early days of the American Revolution, lived and died here. General Sir Henry Clinton, who later held the same command, also died here.
